ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The graph of the linear function $y=kx+b$ (where $k$ and $b$ are constants) is shown in the figure. What is the solution set of the linear inequality in one variable $kx+b\ge 0$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} When $x\leq 3$, $y\geq 0$, \\
hence the solution set of the linear inequality in one variable $kx+b\geq 0$ with respect to $x$ is $\boxed{x\leq 3}$.
